verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say users can prompt AI agents to fix, update, and ship code from inside the Netlify dashboard using their project context. That is a built-in, in-product way to delegate tasks to an AI assistant. The evidence is a single short documentation line with no detail and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which tasks can be delegated and how the agent behaves, any limits or review steps, and independent or community corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Prompt AI agents to fix, update, and ship code using your unique project context directly from your Netlify dashboard.
